description: Golden set v2: gold as text from the corpus, spans resolved by code.

items.question: How many business days of vacation do I get per year?
items.expected_answer: 15 business days per calendar year, prorated during the first year.

gold.text: All full-time employees accrue **15 business days of vacation per calendar year**

items.old_expected_fragment: All full-time employees accrue 15 business days of vacation per calendar year

items.question: If I don't use all my vacation days this year, how many can I carry over to next year?
items.expected_answer: Up to a maximum of 5 days; the rest is forfeited on December 31 unless HR authorizes otherwise.

gold.text: Unused days may be carried over from one year to the next up to a maximum of **5 days**

items.old_expected_fragment: Unused days may be carried over from one year to the next up to a maximum of 5 days

items.question: How far in advance do I need to request my vacation?
items.expected_answer: At least 10 business days in advance, with approval from the direct manager.

gold.text: must be submitted **at least 10 business days in advance**

items.old_expected_fragment: must be submitted at least 10 business days in advance

items.question: How many days do I need to work from the office under the hybrid schedule?

items.old_expected_fragment: 3 days of in-office work and 2 days of remote work per week
